prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production master pose for future 2D sprite animation in a macOS mascot app.
Input Image 1: approved current icy glass ghost mascot, identity, face, material and lighting reference.
Input Image 2: early three-shape concept, silhouette reference ONLY, ignore all text and background.
Create a NEW SINGLE TRANSFORMED FORM of exactly the SAME character from image 1, not a new character. Preserve its luminous silver icy blue opalescent translucent frosted-glass/jelly material, subtle lilac edge refraction, gentle volumetric studio lighting upper left, premium smooth high-end 3D quality and two clean solid luminous white vertical oval eyes. Eyes have NO pupils. NO mouth, NO nose, NO blush.
The face sits clearly in the UPPER THIRD of the body. The LOWER HALF of the body is a clean, empty, slightly darker translucent glass viewing chamber with low-frequency smooth shading and no opaque bright reflections through its centre. This empty lower chamber is specifically reserved for a replaceable company/AI-agent logo to be composited later BELOW the face. Do NOT draw a logo, emblem, nose, energy core, sphere inside sphere, star, badge or any internal object. No central bright spot. The character must be beautiful alone without any logo.
Centered square composition, front view, barely any perspective, subject completely visible with generous uniform transparent safe margins. Largest body dimension exactly about 76% of canvas. Same face and material across all transformed forms. No hands or arms or feet in transformed form: ghost limbs and scallops have smoothly absorbed into the new silhouette. Polished continuous volume.
TRUE transparent background RGBA cutout, no floor, ground shadow, checkerboard, opaque rectangle, vignette, atmospheric scene, text, labels, interface, frames, watermark or multiple subjects. Smooth clean alpha edge; all finite subtle glow fades to true alpha.
FORM: a perfectly round, squishy spherical glass orb spirit. A clear circular silhouette and convincingly three-dimensional sphere, NOT a flat circle or disk. Calm friendly slightly curious expression through the luminous eyes. Empty lower glass chamber, intact smooth spherical bottom. Think ghost tucked into a soft glass ball.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: alternate key pose of an existing mascot, for future sprite animation.
Reference image: approved icy blue glass ghost, use its material, lighting and exact face identity ONLY. Create one full-body cute FIRE FLAME mascot transformation of this same character. It must immediately read as the familiar FIRE emoji silhouette / dancing candle flame, not a generic blob, a drop of water, a crescent moon, comma, paisley or tadpole.
Keep pearlescent translucent frosted-glass / opalescent jelly volume, icy blue and faint lilac refraction, white-blue rim light, soft studio lighting upper left. Exactly TWO luminous ivory-white vertical oval eyes, no dark pupils, no mouth, no nose, no blush. Face clearly readable in the central upper rounded area. Empty lower body, no energy core, no logo, no inner flame emblem or other object.
Important silhouette: a BROAD CHUBBY CONTINUOUS ROUNDED BOTTOM like a small rounded bowl, carrying UPWARD RISING tapered flame tongues with curved pointed tips at the TOP. The base is soft and round, no separate feet or hands. Absolutely NO long curling lower tail, no side hook at the bottom, no crescent-shaped cutout. The upper flame contour is what makes it FIRE.
Centered orthographic front view on a square canvas, ONE subject with 10-12% transparent margin on all sides, premium sculptural 3D render, controlled highlights, gentle inner illumination, finite subtle glow. TRUE transparent alpha background. No text, labels, diagrams, backdrop, floor, shadow plane, checkerboard, watermark, firewood or candles. This is a production character cutout, not a concept sheet.
VARIANT A — CLASSIC SINGLE CANDLE FLAME: a SIMPLE iconic fire silhouette, short and chubby, roughly height 1.35 times width. One large smoothly curved flame tip rising from a broad round teardrop body and leaning slightly right. A clear concave shoulder halfway up the right edge makes it read as fire, not a symmetrical water droplet. Rounded large lower bulb, no tail. Calm, adorable, cleanest and simplest flame silhouette.

scope: Three static transformed masters and layered branding samples for future frame animation. No generated in-between frames and no native app integration.
